author: taulepton_
content: Hi there! How can I help 🙂

author: chainsplit
content: Hello! I’m working with <@828513536145621013> on bringing optional execution proofs to the Grandine client. Our proposal was recently merged into the [Cohort Seven repo](https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-seven/blob/main/projects/grandine-optional-execution-proofs.md). I’d value your feedback, especially on the approach and any edge cases we may have missed.

author: taulepton_
content: I just took a look at the note, on first review everything looks reasonable to me. I would note that there is likely to be substantial changes in the coming weeks to simplify the protocol. Specifically around syncing using proofs - tldr we will introduce recursive execution proofs such that a single proof can verify correctness of the entire chain from the weak subjectivity checkpoint to the head. As a consequence of this change we will deprecate the proof sycn req-resp protocol and exclusively leverage proof gossip over libp2p. I hope to make he ammendments to the specs over the next few weeks.
